rules.name: eth_sync
rules.why: booked deposits and ETH held move together

rules.name: sum_backed
rules.why: sum of balances backed by ETH

rules.name: deposit_credit_exact
rules.expr: ok and called("deposit") and post("balanceOf", sender) + pre("ETH", A0) != pre("balanceOf", sender) + post("ETH", A0)

rules.name: depositfor_credit
rules.expr: ok and called("depositFor") and post("balanceOf", arg(0)) + pre("ETH", A0) != pre("balanceOf", arg(0)) + post("ETH", A0)

rules.name: deposit_nonzero
rules.expr: ok and (called("deposit") or called("depositFor")) and post("ETH", A0) == pre("ETH", A0)

rules.name: withdraw_debit
rules.expr: ok and called("withdraw") and sender != U1 and post("balanceOf", sender) + arg(0) != pre("balanceOf", sender)

rules.name: withdraw_eth_bound
rules.expr: ok and (called("withdraw") or called("withdrawAll")) and post("ETH", sender) > pre("ETH", sender) + pre("balanceOf", sender)
rules.why: never receive more ETH than balance

rules.name: withdraw_eth_out
rules.expr: ok and called("withdraw") and sender != U1 and post("ETH", A0) + arg(0) != pre("ETH", A0)

rules.name: withdrawall_eth_out
rules.expr: ok and called("withdrawAll") and sender != U1 and post("ETH", A0) + pre("balanceOf", sender) != pre("ETH", A0)

rules.name: withdrawall_zero
rules.expr: ok and called("withdrawAll") and sender != U1 and post("balanceOf", sender) != 0

rules.name: loss_custom
rules.expr: ok and u != sender and post("balanceOf", u) < pre("balanceOf", u) and pre("balanceOf", u) > post("balanceOf", u) + pre("allowance", u, sender)

rules.name: transferfrom_allowance
rules.expr: ok and called("transferFrom") and pre("allowance", arg(0), sender) != 115792089237316195423570985008687907853269984665640564039457584007913129639935 and post("allowance", arg(0), sender) + arg(2) != pre("allowance", arg(0), sender)

rules.name: transfer_exact
rules.expr: ok and called("transfer") and arg(0) != sender and (post("balanceOf", sender) + arg(1) != pre("balanceOf", sender) or post("balanceOf", arg(0)) != pre("balanceOf", arg(0)) + arg(1))

rules.name: transfers_no_eth
rules.expr: ok and (called("transfer") or called("transferFrom") or called("approve")) and (post("ETH", A0) != pre("ETH", A0) or post("totalDeposits") != pre("totalDeposits"))
rules.why: internal transfers do not move ETH or total

rules.name: approve_sets
rules.expr: ok and called("approve") and post("allowance", sender, arg(0)) != arg(1)
